title: 梅西告别阿根廷与皮皮虾的超级眼睛

blocks.en: Welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we start with big football news: a true king of football has played his last game for his country. Then we dive under the sea to meet a tiny shrimp with amazing eyes. Let's jump in!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天我们先看一则足球大新闻：一位真正的球王，刚刚踢完了他在国家队的最后一场比赛。然后我们潜入海底，去认识一只眼睛超级厉害的小虾。开始吧！

blocks.en: Lionel Messi has played his last game for Argentina. In his farewell match against Benin, the blue and white team won three-zero, and Messi was the star of the night: he scored one goal and made two assists — he had a hand in every goal of the game.
blocks.title: 梅西告别阿根廷
blocks.cn: 莱昂内尔·梅西踢完了他为阿根廷队的最后一场比赛。在对阵贝宁的告别战中，蓝白军团三比零获胜，梅西是当晚的明星：他打进一球、送出两次助攻——这场比赛的每一个进球，都和他有关。

blocks.en: More than eighty-five thousand fans filled the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires to say goodbye. Messi first played for Argentina twenty-one years ago. He has played two hundred and eight games for his country and scored one hundred and twenty-six goals — more than any other Argentine player in history.
blocks.title: 梅西告别阿根廷
blocks.cn: 八万五千多名球迷涌入布宜诺斯艾利斯的纪念碑球场，来和他告别。梅西二十一年前第一次为阿根廷队出场。此后他共为国家队踢了二百零八场比赛、打进一百二十六个球——比历史上任何一位阿根廷球员都多。

blocks.en: With Argentina, Messi won the World Cup and two Copa América titles. After the game, he told his fans: "Yesterday was my last game, and I already miss wearing the blue and white." For Messi, that famous shirt is like a second skin — saying goodbye was not easy.
blocks.title: 梅西告别阿根廷
blocks.cn: 随阿根廷队，梅西赢得过世界杯冠军和两次美洲杯冠军。赛后他对球迷说：“昨天是我最后一场比赛，我已经开始想念穿蓝白球衣的日子了。”对梅西来说，那件著名的球衣就像他的第二层皮肤——说再见并不容易。

blocks.en: And here is the warmest part of the story. Cristiano Ronaldo, Messi's greatest rival for twenty years, left a message under Messi's post: "Leo, so many years defending your country, and a story that will live on forever. You have all my respect. A hug." Two kings, one kind message: great rivals can also be great friends. Their story will inspire young players for years to come.
blocks.title: 梅西告别阿根廷
blocks.cn: 而这个故事最暖心的部分在这里。克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多——梅西二十年来最大的对手——在梅西的帖子下留言：“Leo，这么多年为你的国家拼搏，你的故事将永远流传。你所取得的一切，赢得了我全部的尊重。抱抱。”两位球王，一句暖心的留言：伟大的对手，也可以是伟大的朋友。他们的故事将激励年轻球员很多很多年。

blocks.en: Now meet the mantis shrimp, a small sea animal with a very big superpower. It is famous for two things: a punch faster than a speeding bullet, and truly amazing eyes.
blocks.title: 皮皮虾的超级眼睛
blocks.cn: 现在来认识一下螳螂虾（皮皮虾），一种个头不大、超能力却很强的海洋小动物。它有两样出名之处：一记比飞行的子弹还快的“拳头”，和一双真正令人惊叹的眼睛。

blocks.en: Your eyes have three kinds of color sensors. The mantis shrimp has many, many more. Scientists from Belgium and Germany studied seventeen light pigments inside its eyes. Pigments are the tiny parts that catch light and turn it into pictures for the brain.
blocks.title: 皮皮虾的超级眼睛
blocks.cn: 你的眼睛有三种颜色感应器。螳螂虾的要多得多。来自比利时和德国的科学家研究了它眼睛里的十七种感光色素。色素是眼睛里负责捕捉光线、把光线变成图像传给大脑的微小部件。

blocks.en: They found something nobody expected: four of the pigments work like tiny light switches. Red light can switch them on, and blue light can switch them back off. Other pigments answer to blue and orange light. With all these clever switches, the shrimp can see colors of light that our eyes cannot see at all.
blocks.title: 皮皮虾的超级眼睛
blocks.cn: 他们发现了一件谁也没想到的事：其中四种色素就像微小的光开关。红光可以把它们打开，蓝光又能把它们关回去。还有一些色素对蓝光和橙光有反应。有了这些聪明的开关，皮皮虾能看到我们的眼睛根本看不到的光色。

blocks.en: Why does this matter to us? Doctors dream of tools that use light to switch tiny parts of the body on and off — a little like fixing a machine with a flashlight. The shrimp's eyes may give scientists new ideas for such tools. Nature, once again, built it first!
blocks.title: 皮皮虾的超级眼睛
blocks.cn: 这对我们有什么意义呢？医生们梦想着能有这样的工具：用光来打开或关闭身体里的微小部件——有点像用手电筒修机器。皮皮虾的眼睛也许能给科学家带来新点子。大自然，又一次抢先造出来了！

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "hang up your boots." Football players wear special boots to play. When a player retires and stops playing, we say he hangs up his boots — he puts them away and does not wear them again.
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今日俚语：“hang up your boots”（挂靴）。球员踢球时穿着特殊的球鞋。当一位球员退役、不再踢球时，我们就说他“挂靴”了——他把球鞋收起来，不再穿了。

blocks.en: For example: "Messi has hung up his boots for Argentina, but he still plays for his club team." Hanging up your boots for one team does not always mean goodbye to football forever!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 比如：“梅西已经为阿根廷队挂靴了，但他还会继续为俱乐部踢球。”为一支球队挂靴，并不总是意味着永远告别足球！

blocks.en: So — one day, when your grandpa says he is too old to play football with you on Sundays, you can smile and say: "Grandpa has hung up his boots!" But be careful — he might just put them back on!
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 所以——等哪天爷爷说他太老了、不能在周日陪你踢球了，你就可以笑着说：“爷爷挂靴啦！”不过小心——他可能转身又把鞋穿回去了！

blocks.en: That brings us to the end of today's show! Here's a question: If your favorite player played one last game, what would you say to him? "Thank you"? "Please don't go"? Or "Can I have your boots"?
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里！留一个问题：如果你最喜欢的球员要踢最后一场比赛，你会对他说什么？“谢谢你”？“别走”？还是“能把你的球鞋送给我吗”？

blocks.en: Have a wonderful day, and see you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 祝你有美好的一天，明天早上见！

（C 罗在梅西的帖子下面留了言）。
Messi's greatest rival for twenty years
，紧跟在名字后面补充说明"这个人是谁"——梅西二十年来最大的对手。新闻英语介绍人物时，常常这样在名字后加一个同位语，一句话就交代清身份。
so many years defending your country
是"保卫、为国效力"，补充说明梅西这么多年一直在做的事。分词的动作和主语是主动关系，所以用 -ing 形式。
a story that will live on forever
在从句里作主语，指代"这个故事"。
点名（C 罗）→ 补身份（最大对手）→ 动作（留言）→ 引语里先说多年付出（分词短语）→ 再说故事永存（定语从句）
。一句话既有新闻事实、又有温度，是体育新闻"写人物"的经典句型。

5 → D (What Would You Say to Your Hero?)
